title: Cheapest Gyms in New Plymouth – No Contract Options 2026
meta_desc: Find the most affordable gyms in New Plymouth for 2026. Compare no‑contract options, the cheapest weekly rates, and how the Exercise NZ subsidy can slash costs.
intro: New Plymouth’s love of the outdoors translates into a thriving gym market where you can stay fit without breaking the bank. From women‑only spaces to 24/7 chains, there are solid choices across the CBD, Strandon, Moturoa and Westown.

sections.heading: Active, affordable fitness in New Plymouth
sections.body: Taranaki’s adventure‑loving community fuels a high participation rate in sport and recreation – Stats NZ reports over 70% of adults engage in regular physical activity. That demand keeps gym membership prices competitive, especially in suburbs like Inglewood where new facilities are vying for members. Below we break down the cheapest no‑contract option, the best‑value contract, and the premium pick, plus how the Exercise NZ subsidy can dramatically lower any price.

sections.heading: Contours – Cheapest no‑contract gym
sections.body: Contours is a women‑only gym located on the corner of Queen Street and offers a straightforward month‑to‑month plan at $15.95 per week. There’s no lock‑in, so you can cancel at any time – ideal for students, mums returning to the gym, or anyone testing the waters. The club’s smaller size means less crowding and a supportive community vibe, especially popular in the CBD and Strandon areas.
list: No initiation fee or long‑term contract
Limited equipment compared with larger chains

sections.heading: Snap Fitness – Best value with a 12‑month contract
sections.body: Snap Fitness operates two sites (CBD and Westown) and runs a 12‑month contract at $19.95 per week. New members receive six weeks free, effectively dropping the first month’s cost to about $13.95. The chain is open 24 hours, so you can fit workouts around shift work or family commitments. While the contract is required, the free‑week incentive and relatively low weekly price make it the best overall value in town.
list: 6 weeks free for new members – equivalent to ~30% off the first three months
Contract required – early termination fee applies

sections.heading: Anytime Fitness – Premium 24/7 access
sections.body: Anytime Fitness is the premium pick for members who need unrestricted hours and worldwide access. The New Plymouth club charges $20.95 per week on a 12‑month contract and includes key‑card entry 24 hours a day, plus the ability to use any of the 5,000+ Anytime locations worldwide when travelling. The club is modern, offers a wider range of cardio and strength equipment, and runs regular HIIT and yoga sessions. The higher price reflects the added convenience and global network.
list: Modern equipment and diverse class schedule

sections.heading: Exercise NZ subsidy and price comparison
sections.body: If you’re eligible for the Exercise NZ programme – for example, recent graduates, unemployed or those who haven’t been active for 12 months – you can claim a 40‑70% discount on the weekly rate. The exact reduction depends on your income bracket. For a $20 /week membership, the subsidy could bring the cost down to $6‑12 per week, making even premium clubs affordable.
